reasons: The cited warranty section (p0024–p0026) covers only legal compliance, authority/rights and non-infringement, with no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy; combined with the implied-warranty disclaimer in 5(e), the clause falls below even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies), so 'deviation' is correctly classified.

The redline is actionable and proportionate: it inserts a 90-day conformance warranty tied to the defined Specifications, the professional/workmanlike standard, a no-malicious-code warranty, the re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy, and an express carve-out so 5(e) does not swallow the new express warranties — matching the rule's redline guidance without disturbing existing counterparty-favorable text.

The failed deterministic period check is a false negative: the inserted text expressly states 'for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery', which satisfies the fallback period; the placement immediately after 5(e) with a cross-reference disclaiming any cut-back is workable even though a slot inside the warranty list would be tidier.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the required prefix, states what changed and why, and offers the 30-day services fallback as the playbook contemplates.
